name: week
title: Supplier tender review
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Prices remain in each tender currency.

sections.title: Tender dates and overdue work
sections.sql: select reference,name,owner,currency,status,closes_on,scores_missing,overdue_questions from tender_week order by closes_on

sections.title: Missing bids
sections.sql: select reference,supplier,expected_lots,quoted_lots,missing_lots from bid_coverage where participation='active' order by reference,supplier

sections.title: Scoring still required
sections.sql: select reference,supplier,criterion,reviewer from scoring_gaps order by reference,supplier

sections.title: Comparable offers
sections.note: Blank totals or scores mean incomplete evidence. Scores are not a decision.
sections.sql: select reference,supplier,currency,total,max_lead_days,weighted_score,open_questions from comparison order by reference,supplier

sections.title: Record exceptions
sections.sql: select reference,rule,issue from compliance_checks order by reference,rule
